name: RadioButton
description: The RadioButton component provides a customizable radio input control that allows users to select one option from a group.
usage: Three size options: small, medium, and large
Support for both text and component labels
examples:
<RadioButton
  id="small-radio"
  name="size-example"
  value="small"
  checked={selected === 'small'}
  onChange={handleChange}
  size="sm"
  label="Small"
/>

<RadioButton
  id="medium-radio"
  name="size-example"
  value="medium"
  checked={selected === 'medium'}
  onChange={handleChange}
  size="md"
  label="Medium"
/>

<RadioButton
  id="large-radio"
  name="size-example"
  value="large"
  checked={selected === 'large'}
  onChange={handleChange}
  size="lg"
  label="Large"
/>

<RadioButton
  id="disabled-radio"
  name="disabled-example"
  value="disabled"
  checked={true}
  onChange={() => {}}
  disabled={true}
  label="Disabled option"
/>
